messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell doctor about illness or infection in past few weeks"
set: ["tell doctor about illness or infection in past few weeks", "first few weeks", "taken for few days or weeks", "tell doctor about vitamins", "tell doctor about minerals", "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide", "tell doctor about all medications", "tell doctor about herbal products", "tell your doctor if side effects last for more than a few weeks", "tell doctor about sudden mood or behavior changes", "tell doctor about history of seizures or epilepsy", "tell doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines", "tell doctor about all current medicines", "tell doctor about all medical conditions", "tell doctor about all other medicines", "tell doctor about all prescription medications"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
